name: Euterpe — AfroMeet Patron Agent
description: Euterpe is AfroMeet's autonomous patron of African creators. She discovers new music, film, writing, art and photography on AfroMeet, samples works by paying per-access nanopayments via x402, evaluates them (Claude judgment + on-chain access-revenue momentum), and backs promising creators by buying fractional shares and streaming — all settled in USDC on Arc.

provider.name: AfroMeet
provider.description: Decentralised platform for African creatives to own, monetise and govern their work onchain.

skills.name: Discover creators
skills.description: Enumerates active creative works on AfroMeet across music, video, writing, artwork and photography.

skills.name: Sample via nanopayments
skills.description: Pays per-access discovery nanopayments (x402 / Circle Gateway) to sample a work before deciding.

skills.name: Evaluate works
skills.description: Scores creators from sampled content and on-chain access-revenue momentum.

skills.name: Back creators
skills.description: Buys fractional shares of promising works and streams them, within a USDC budget, then rebalances on revenue signals.
